title: #29 New Inventions
prompt: In our technological world, the number of new inventions has been increasing. Please make an example with its impact on our life, and explain if it is beneficial or detrimental.

modelPlan.focus: evaluate the impact of technological inventions on daily life, focusing on a specific example and its benefits or detriments
keyArguments: Technological inventions have revolutionized daily life by enhancing efficiency and connectivity, as seen in the example of smartphones.
However, over-reliance on such technologies can lead to detrimental effects, such as cognitive overload and the digital divide.
